notice: Research comparison, not a production-detector replacement. Synthetic benchmark measurements; Z995 was adaptively developed on inspected training assets; validation (PUMP-08/09) was already inspected, so its result is descriptive and development-informed. No test asset, telemetry or prediction is included.

validation.scope: Validation · 2 pumps (PUMP-08/09) · 9 events · 14 asset-days · previously inspected
validation.rawNote: Zero applicable raw-aggregation checks: PUMP-08 has no flow meter and PUMP-09 no measured speed, so the hydraulic residual could not be applied. The validation gain comes from the waveform refinement only.
